newsitem.title: FINLAND: TAMRO SAYS BUYS NORWEGIAN HEIGAR.
newsitem.headline: TAMRO SAYS BUYS NORWEGIAN HEIGAR.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals wholesaler Oy Tamro Ab said in a statement on Monday it had bought Norwegian laboratory product dealer Heigar & Co. A/S for an undisclosed sum.
Tamro said its Swedish unit AB Labassco had bought the entire share capital of family-owned Heigar, the net sales of which were about 28 million markka in 1995.
Heigar's share of the laboratory products market in Norway was nearly 10 percent, the same as that of Labassco in Sweden, Tamro said. Its market share in Finland is about 15 percent, it added.
"The acquisition gives the group a firm foothold on the laboratory products market in the Nordic countries," Tamro said.

Heigar imports, markets and distributes laboratory supplies, chemicals and equipment particularly to research and industrial laboratories in Norway, Tamro said, adding that the company has 24 employees.
